Field book of a randomised layout

Source: R/generator.R
field_book.Rd

The field book of make_design() with empty columns for the responses to be measured, ready to be filled in and analysed with design_anova().

Usage

field_book(layout, responses = "Response", file = NULL)

Arguments

layout

An "ad_layout" object.

responses

Names of the response columns to add.

file

Optional CSV file to write.

Value

The field book as a data frame (invisibly when file is given).

Examples

lay <- make_design("rcbd", trt = 4, r = 3, seed = 7)
head(field_book(lay, c("Yield", "Height")))
#>   Plot Block FieldRow FieldCol Treatment Yield Height
#> 1    1     1        1        1        T2    NA     NA
#> 2    2     1        1        2        T3    NA     NA
#> 3    3     1        1        3        T1    NA     NA
#> 4    4     1        1        4        T4    NA     NA
#> 5    5     2        2        4        T4    NA     NA
#> 6    6     2        2        3        T1    NA     NA
